fields.claim: 052's SiC sleeve, bond and node bill is kept. Sourced strut fitting shares (17-70% of the strut) would add 0.2-2.3 times the tube mass. The peak member load, 775 kN, exceeds the largest sourced composite strut test (121.7 klb, 541 kN). Bonded fittings failed at about 70% of design ultimate.
fields.needed_to_ground: A bonded end-fitting test at 775 kN on a 247 mm, 1.45 mm-wall tube.
